'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Ain al-Hilweh clashes]]
**Clashes between rival factions in the [[Ain al-Hilweh]] [[Palestinian refugee camps|Palestinian refugee camp]] in [[Sidon District]], [[Lebanon]], continue for the fifth day, despite a [[ceasefire]], with five more people being killed, bringing the death toll to ten.
